title: Korean Pasta Linguine
description: A fusion dish of Korean and Italian flavors, combining the zesty taste of Korean chili paste with linguine pasta.

ingredients.name: zesty sauce (gochugaru, soy sauce, rice vinegar)

instructions: Cook the linguine pasta according to the package instructions until al dente.
In a large skillet or wok, heat the vegetable oil over medium-high heat.
Add the minced garlic and stir-fry until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Add the Korean chili paste and stir-fry for another minute.
Add the zesty sauce and stir-fry for 2 minutes, until the sauce has thickened.
Add the cooked linguine pasta to the skillet and toss to combine with the sauce.
Top with chopped green onions and toasted sesame seeds (if using).
